content: If the DemFreezeFrameRecordTrigger is set to DEM_TRIG- GER_ON_TEST_FAILED_THIS_OPERATION_CYCLE , the FreezeFrame shall be cap- tured each time the UDS status bit 1 (TFTOC) has a transition from 0 to 1.

If the DemFreezeFrameRecordTrigger is set to DEM_TRIG- GER_ON_TEST_FAILED_THIS_OPERATION_CYCLE , the FreezeFrame shall be cap- tured each time the UDS status bit 1 (TFTOC) has a transition from 0 to 1.
